menu.name: Artisan Flat White
menu.description: Double ristretto extraction of our signature dark roast with silky, textured whole milk. Melbourne-standard coffee in the heart of Ballarat.

menu.name: Belgian Hot Chocolate
menu.description: Melted Belgian couverture chocolate steamed with rich milk, dusted with Dutch cocoa and served with a house marshmallow.

menu.name: L'espresso Magic
menu.description: The Melbourne classic: double ristretto in a 160ml tulip cup with 3/4 steamed milk for the ultimate coffee-to-milk ratio.

menu.name: Famous Smashed Avo on Seeded Sourdough
menu.description: Fresh Hass avocado, marinated Victorian goat feta, toasted dukkah, lemon oil, fresh mint, and two free-range poached eggs on grilled 1816 bakery sourdough.

menu.name: L'espresso Classic Eggs Benedict
menu.description: Toasted buttery brioche, slow-poached free-range eggs, house-whipped tarragon hollandaise with your choice of double-smoked Otway ham or Tasmanian cold-smoked salmon.

menu.name: Avocado & Heirloom Tomato Toast
menu.description: Sliced avocado, charred heirloom truss tomatoes, aged balsamic reduction, basil pesto, and microgreens on toasted light rye sourdough.

menu.name: Truffle & Field Mushroom Scramble
menu.description: Silky scrambled eggs with Victorian truffle butter, sautéed Swiss brown mushrooms, shaved pecorino, and wild rocket on grilled sourdough.

menu.name: Signature Handmade Potato Gnocchi Ragù
menu.description: Pillow-soft hand-rolled potato gnocchi tossed in our 8-hour slow-braised Victorian beef cheek and San Marzano tomato ragù, finished with 24-month Parmigiano Reggiano.

menu.name: Wild Forest Mushroom & Sage Gnocchi
menu.description: Handmade gnocchi pan-crisped in hazelnut brown butter, King oyster and pine mushrooms, crispy sage, and whipped ricotta.

menu.name: Ballarat Porchetta & Provolone Panini
menu.description: Crisp-skinned herb-roasted pork belly, melted provolone cheese, salsa verde, and pickled fennel on toasted crusty ciabatta.

menu.name: Golden Almond Croissant
menu.description: Twice-baked butter croissant loaded with rich frangipane almond cream, toasted flaked almonds, and powdered sugar.

menu.name: Pistachio & Chocolate Babka Knot
menu.description: Twisted brioche pastry ribbons layered with dark chocolate ganache, Bronte pistachios, and orange blossom syrup glaze.

menu.name: Traditional Sicilian Ricotta Cannoli
menu.description: Crisp fried pastry shell piped fresh with sweetened sheep's milk ricotta, candied orange peel, and crushed pistachio tips.

menu.name: Pyrenees Regional Pinot Noir
menu.description: Glass of local cool-climate Western Victoria Pinot Noir. Ripe cherries, subtle French oak, and fine tannins that pair gloriously with gnocchi.

menu.name: King Valley Prosecco DOC
menu.description: Crisp, lively sparkling with green apple and white floral notes. The perfect accompaniment to brunch or eggs benedict.

settings.name: L'espresso
settings.tagline: Iconic Coffee, House Gnocchi & Warm Timber Hospitality
settings.address: 417 Sturt St, Ballarat Central VIC 3350, Australia
settings.bannerNotice: Open Daily: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM • 417 Sturt St, Ballarat Central
settings.heroHeadline: Artisan espresso, hand-rolled gnocchi & warm timber soul.
settings.heroDescription: For decades, L'espresso has been Ballarat’s beloved retreat. Settle into dark leather booths under warm jarrah timber beams, browse our iconic jazz & blues record walls, and enjoy Melbourne-standard coffee, crisp eggs benedict, and slow-cooked beef cheek ragù gnocchi.
settings.storyQuote: Where Italian heritage, jazz vinyl, and Victorian coffee culture come together on Sturt Street.
settings.storyDescription: Founded on Ballarat’s grand central boulevard, L’espresso captures the nostalgic romance of Melbourne’s laneway cafes combined with the deep, unhurried warmth of a North Italian espresso and wine bar.
